title: make / have / let + 사람 + 동사원형 (She let me use it.)
goal: make, have, let을 써서 '~하게 만들다', '~하게 시키다', '~하게 해 주다'를 말할 수 있어요.

points.title: make = 억지로 ~하게 하다
points.body: make + 사람 + 동사원형은 '(싫어도) ~하게 만들다'라는 뜻이에요. My boss made me work on Sunday. 또 '어떤 것 때문에 ~하게 되다'라는 뜻으로도 써요. The movie made me cry. (그 영화 때문에 울었어요.)

points.title: have = 일을 시키다
points.body: have + 사람 + 동사원형은 '(일이나 역할로) ~하게 시키다'예요. 매니저, 셰프, 선생님처럼 시킬 수 있는 사람이 자주 써요. The chef had me cut the onions.

points.title: let = ~하게 해 주다 (허락)
points.body: let + 사람 + 동사원형은 '~하게 해 주다, ~하도록 허락하다'예요. My housemate let me use her laptop. Let me ~는 '제가 ~할게요'라는 뜻으로도 많이 써요. Let me help you.

points.title: to 없이 동사원형만!
points.body: 50강의 want / ask + 사람 + to와 달리, make / have / let 뒤에는 to를 쓰지 않아요. made me to work (X) → made me work (O).

points.title: 과거여도 뒤 동사는 원형
points.body: 과거형은 made, had, let이에요 (let은 과거도 let). 과거라도 뒤에 오는 동사는 그대로 원형이에요. She let me used (X) → She let me use (O).

formula: 과거: made / had / let + 사람 + 동사원형

mistakes.wrong: My boss made me to work on Sunday.
mistakes.right: My boss made me work on Sunday.
mistakes.why: '~하도록'을 to로 옮기기 쉬운데, make 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형만 써요.
let 뒤에도 to를 쓰지 않아요. Let me know.는 '알려 주세요'라는 아주 흔한 표현이에요.

mistakes.wrong: She let me used her car.
mistakes.right: She let me use her car.
mistakes.why: 과거 이야기라도 let 뒤 동사는 원형이에요. 과거는 앞의 let(과거형도 let)이 이미 보여 줘요.

examples.en: My manager made me work late on Friday.
examples.ko: 매니저가 금요일에 저를 늦게까지 일하게 했어요.

examples.en: The sad movie made me cry.
My housemate let me use her hair dryer.
examples.ko: 하우스메이트가 자기 드라이기를 쓰게 해 줬어요.

examples.en: Let me help you with your bags.
The chef had me cut the onions.
Please let me know your answer by Monday.
The farm owner didn't let us take a break.
examples.ko: 농장 주인이 우리를 쉬게 해 주지 않았어요.

examples.en: My boss makes me wear a uniform.

quiz.sentence: My boss made me ___ on Sunday.
quiz.why: make + 사람 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형 work

quiz.sentence: My housemate ___ me use her laptop.
quiz.why: '~하게 해 주다'는 let + 사람 + 동사원형. allow는 allowed me to use처럼 to가 필요해요.

quiz.ko: 그 슬픈 노래는 나를 울게 해요.
quiz.why: make + 사람 + 동사원형 → makes me cry

quiz.sentence: The chef had me ___ the dishes.
quiz.why: have + 사람 + 동사원형 → had me wash
'알려 주세요'는 Let me know. let이 '~하게 해 주다'예요.

quiz.answer: My manager made me work late.
choices: My manager made me work late.
My manager made me to work late.
My manager made me working late.
My manager made me worked late.

quiz.ko: 엄마는 제가 혼자 여행하게 해 주지 않았어요.
quiz.answer: My mum didn't let me travel alone.
choices: My mum didn't let me travel alone.
My mum didn't let me to travel alone.
My mum didn't let me traveled alone.
My mum didn't let me travels alone.
quiz.why: let + 사람 + 동사원형. 부정문이어도 travel은 원형

quiz.ko: 선생님이 우리에게 그 문장을 다시 읽게 했어요.
quiz.answer: The teacher had us read the sentence again.
choices: The teacher had us read the sentence again.
The teacher had us to read the sentence again.
The teacher had we read the sentence again.
The teacher had us reads the sentence again.
The movie made me to laugh.
The movie made to me laugh.

quiz.answer: Can you let me know your address?
choices: Can you let me know your address?
Can you let me to know your address?
Can you let me knowing your address?
Can you let to me know your address?
quiz.why: let me know가 한 덩어리. to를 넣지 않아요.

quiz.answer: The supervisor had me check the boxes.
choices: The supervisor had me check the boxes.
The supervisor had me checked the boxes.
The supervisor had me to check the boxes.
The supervisor had to me check the boxes.
